description: **Retired choices.** A value flag or positional arg that declares `Choices` may also declare the spellings it used to accept, through `RetiredChoices(RetiredChoice("old", "use 'new'"))` and its `ArgRetiredChoices` twin. A value matching one is refused at parse time with the message naming its replacement, ahead of the invalid-value check and from every source the choices check already reaches. A retired value is not a choice: help never lists it, and the published `value_schema` enum and MCP tool schema carry the live set only. `--dump-schema` publishes the declaration as a `retired_choices` map.
